basic_info.description: Newly remodeled top floor flat designed for tranquility and comfort. This home is eligible for Fast Track Condo Conversion and is within a beautifully renovated two-unit building. High quality finishes throughout and outfitted with advanced soundproofing features, this home features an expansive front living room with gracious double-paned windows that frame the picturesque landscape and mature trees of the Panhandle providing a tranquil backdrop for everyday life. Skylights send light throughout and an open kitchen and dining area serve as the heart of the home. Stunning natural stone countertops, high-end stainless steel appliances, instant hot water, pot filler and beautiful cabinetry grace the kitchen. There is a split bathroom off the main hallway and two serene bedrooms. One bedroom serves as a primary suite with an en-suite spa-like full bathroom. Soundproofed flooring, ceiling and walls, in-unit laundry, all new electrical, pre-wired for Cat6, new plumbing and tankless water heaters, and multi-zone hydronic floor heat. The building includes an expansive garage with  1-car parking and ample storage. This special near Cole Valley, NOPA, Haight, Inner Sunset, UCSF, Kezar, USF and at the entrance of endless trails, bike routes and various attractions of Golden Gate Park.
